payload.text: AI can auto‑generate boilerplate and catch regressions, but the hard part—defining system boundaries, threat models, and long‑term maintainability—still needs a human mind.
A useful test is to give a coding agent a new microservice spec and see if it can produce a secure, well‑documented API without any human‑written design notes; today it stalls on trade‑off decisions.

Your triage pipeline assumes static analysis and a checklist catch all subtle threats, yet many vulnerabilities arise from context‑specific logic that tools miss. How will you verify that the automated stage doesn’t let a critical flaw slip through before granting auto‑approval?
